_comment: The lead agent's limits (HIR-266, HIR-280), read by scripts/lead_pick.py. daily_cap_eur is the model-call spend the lead agent may start in one day, over all of that day's runs; 0 stops every run. Raising it is a recurring cost, so it is Chandler's call (AGENTS.md "What Chandler is asked", item 5). max_decisions_waiting is the pile of real decisions waiting for Chandler at which tickets likely to add one are held (his number, 12 Nov). queue_min is how many run-alone tickets the lead agent keeps waiting in Todo. There is no count of tickets per day.
